sentences.en: He was encouraged by a professor from his college days.
sentences.zh: 他在大学时的一位教授鼓励了他。

sentences.en: It is necessary for you to go and encourage the girl.
sentences.zh: 你有必要去鼓励一下那个女孩。

sentences.en: Dozens of people encouraged me to fulfill my ambitions.
sentences.zh: 好多人鼓励我要实现我的梦想。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：en（使…）+courage（勇气）→使有勇气→鼓励
